title: snowpack v1: weather-driven 3D snow column with time scrub and shove test
description: Browser-only Three.js site. Open-Meteo hourly record for Thredbo Top Station -> pure snowpack layer model -> 3D column; single UI element is a time bar (first snowfall to now). Push on the column fails the weakest interface below the push and the slab slides. Deploy to GitHub Pages via Actions. Architecture: weather adapters -> record schema -> model step fn -> hourly snapshots -> mechanics -> scene -> interaction.
notes:
Interaction spec (Rob, 2026-09-15): open on a white screen; four clicks each cut one wall of the column (shovel cuts), camera zooms in on the freed column. Then: (a) push the column from the side at a height -> weakest interface below the push fails, slab slides; (b) hover top -> shovel appears; click = quick light tap, click+hold winds the arm up (to ~90deg) and release slaps harder -> compression-test style load from the top. Single UI: time bar (first snowfall -> now / season end, never future) plus a tiny season picker top-left. Bare stage. No server: browser fetches Open-Meteo directly; data-in-git collector is a later optional slot.

Progress 2026-09-15 late: browser-tested end to end (intro cuts, fly-in, scrub, season picker, shovel tap, side push, slab release). Model: implicit surface energy balance; percolation refreezes against cold content; precipFactor calibrated 1.9 vs Spencers Creek 2026/2022. 21 tests pass. Not pushed yet.

Direction change 2026-09-15 pm (Rob): interactions were janky -> removed intro cuts, shovel, push/tap, slide. Now: load in, one square column (0.4 m) on a flat 32-degree low-poly green slope, layers sheared with the slope, snow in whites/greys with crusts see-through blue, thin red seams between layers, time bar + season picker + hover labels. See ai-notes/02.

Late pm: translucent snow, seams coloured green->red by bond strength, dark stage, printed height strip + top-face total, fixed hover panel (snow vs boundary), white edge highlight, melt-freeze modelled as surface crusts (soakTop/refreezeTop). Tests 21 pass. Not pushed.

Evening: bond strengths now from Jamieson & Johnston 2001 density regressions + Roch friction; colours = stability index S. Subagents (6 of 8) never started; research done directly. Two cards (snow/boundary). Not pushed.

Night: station corrections (BOM DWO anchors, gauge rain, wind x2) -> RMSE 9-10 cm; model fixes from 10-day audit (wind skin, crust split, slush); physics consolidated in src/snow with README register. Not pushed.

Second audit done; BOM max-window convention fixed; anchors for 9am/3pm/min/max; wind x2 snow x2.4 -> RMSE 8 cm. Not pushed.

Observations: SnowPilot AU pits fixture + compare script; MSC 2026 daily reports in page; Snowy Hydro daily sensor digitised from PDF chart -> daily calibration (bias +1, RMSE 10). Not pushed.
